stem: Ira ties thread on a circular board with $8$ pegs, stepping a fixed gap of $3$ pegs each time. She asks whether the thread will eventually reach every peg.

options.text: Answer with the phrase thread-gap alone, instead of checking $8$ and $3$.
Yes: $8$ and $3$ share no common factor greater than $1$, so stepping by $3$ visits every peg before repeating.
Say that reaching every peg is what creates the co-primality of $8$ and $3$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Because $\gcd(8,3)=1$, repeated steps of $3$ cycle through all $8$ pegs before returning to the start.

teacher.key_rationale: Co-primality of peg count and gap predicts full coverage. Naming the gap phrase alone substitutes a label. Saying coverage creates co-primality reverses the relation.
